package.description: Command-line tool for managing FIDO2 security keys: passkeys, PINs, PIN policy, fingerprints, and factory reset.

en-US.author: TOKEN2 Sàrl
en-US.description: Command-line tool for managing FIDO2 security keys: passkeys, PINs, PIN policy, fingerprints, and factory reset.
en-US.longDescription:
fido2-manage is an open-source, cross-platform command-line tool for managing FIDO2 security keys over USB and NFC. It handles passkeys (resident keys), PINs, minimum PIN length, enforced user verification, fingerprint enrollment, and factory reset.
Its flag set is drop-in compatible with the classic fido2-manage.exe, so existing scripts keep working. The portable Windows package also bundles the Token2 Key Manager graphical front-end and the token2-piv-tool command-line utilities.
en-US.name: fido2-manage
en-US.releaseNotes:
Release version in the window title and About page
Warning if pcscd is not detected
Improved AppImage release (runs without extra installation, tested on Fedora44/45, Ubuntu26, Debian13)

zh-CN.description: 管理 FIDO2 安全密钥的命令行工具：通行密钥、PIN 码、PIN 策略、指纹与恢复出厂设置。
zh-CN.longDescription:
fido2-manage 是一款开源的跨平台命令行工具，用于通过 USB 和 NFC 管理 FIDO2 安全密钥。它支持通行密钥（设备端密钥）、PIN 码、最小 PIN 长度、强制用户验证、指纹录入以及恢复出厂设置等操作。
其参数集与经典版 fido2-manage.exe 完全兼容，现有脚本无需修改即可继续使用。Windows 便携包中还包含 Token2 Key Manager 图形界面前端和 token2-piv-tool 命令行工具。
